artworks.title: Mask of the Abbé Raynal
artworks.artist: Jules de Goncourt, after Maurice-Quentin de La Tour
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on blue  wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person's face, focusing on their facial features without including the body. The face is depicted in a forward-facing position, showing the person's eyes, nose, lips, and hair. The background is a plain, light blue paper.

artworks.title: Academy
artworks.medium: softground etching and roulette, printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a reclining pose, with emphasis on the upper torso, arm, and legs. The individual is leaning against a background, with indistinct facial features and loosely draped clothing covering the lower body. The right arm is extended, holding a shallow bowl or cup. The background is textured and abstract, with variations in shading and tone.

artworks.title: Ships in a Stormy Sea
artworks.medium: pen and ink with gray wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a stormy sea with turbulent waves and several ships with full sails navigating the rough waters. The horizon is obscured by clouds blending with the sky. The artwork is in a monochromatic palette of varying shades of gray. The brushwork is smooth, capturing the fluidity of the scene. Thick, heavy clouds suggest impending or recent rainfall. The overall palette and technique intensify the nautical scene.

artworks.title: Addie Card, 12 years old. Spinner in cotton mill, North Pownal, Vermont
artworks.description: This sepia-toned photograph depicts a young girl standing next to a piece of machinery in an industrial setting. The girl has pale skin and dark hair that is tied up behind her head, and she looks out at us with large eyes and a neutral expression. She is wearing a plaid apron over a patterned dress with rolled-up sleeves, and her feet are bare and dirty. She has one of her arms bent behind her, resting casually on the large machine, which is full of spindles and spools loaded with white thread. Debris is scattered on the dark wooden floor.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and a Woman
artworks.medium: 2 daguerreotypes with applied color in a brass locket
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person in a small locket. The portrait shows the person from the shoulders up, facing the viewer with a slight angle. The individual has fair skin, dark hair styled neatly around the head, and is wearing a dark garment with a white lace collar. The person has gold earrings and a jeweled brooch at the neck. The portrait is encased in an ornate round metal frame with a floral or leaf design, with a hinged metal cover opened to reveal the portrait. The background of the portrait is plain, and the locket is set against a black background.

artworks.title: Portraits of Three Women, Two Men and Three Children
artworks.medium: 4 daguerreotypes with applied color in a brass locket
artworks.dimensions:
image (each): 3.3 × 3.3 cm (1 5/16 × 1 5/16 in.)
overall (locket closed): 6 × 4.3 × 1 cm (2 3/8 × 1 11/16 × 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features an open locket containing two daguerreotype photographs. On the left side is a photo of a young adult and a child. The young adult is wearing a dark suit with a patterned tie and neat dark hair, appearing serious. The child is dressed in a patterned outfit with short light hair. On the right side is a photo of a man and woman. The man has a beard and mustache, wearing a formal suit with a vest, white shirt, and cravat. His hair is styled in a side part. The woman's hair is styled in a bun, wearing a dark dress with intricate patterns and a high lace collar fastened with a brooch. Both photos are in an ornate round metal locket with a handle. The background in each photo is plain and neutral. The locket has a decorated hinge and edging, with a black background outside emphasizing its vintage appearance.

artworks.title: The Mystic Marriage of Saint Catherine
artworks.medium: black chalk over a black chalk counterproof on laid paper with brown ink borderline
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone in honor of Louis and Matthieu de Bayser
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures positioned in a dynamic composition. The central person, seated, with a baby in her lap, is surrounded by other figures standing or seated on steps. The people have classical facial features and flowing hair, wearing robes or drapery. Above them, cherubic figures hover amidst clouds. The background includes an architectural column, an ascending staircase, and more figures engaged in various activities, such as reading or music.

artworks.title: The Ballet
artworks.medium: pastel on light tan paper mounted on board
artworks.description: A man wearing a black suit stands in the middle of a line of five ballerinas on a stage in this vertical pastel drawing. The dancer closest to us is cut off by the right edge of the sheet, and the line of dancers angles away from us to our left. The ballerinas’ white costumes have off-the-shoulder bodices and knee-length tutus. Black ribbons encircle their necks and wrists, and their tights and slippers are bright, carnation pink. Pink and white flowers adorn their hair and dresses. The man in black is balding and has a dark goatee. He stands next to the dancer closest to us. Three dancers on his far side seem to stand casually in the wings of the stage, their feet outturned. The final dancer, farther from us, is bright in the stage lights. The floor is ash-gray, and the backdrop is drawn loosely with visible strokes in pine green, ochre yellow, lapis and ice blue. A narrow margin lines the edges of the tan paper. The artist signed the lower left corner, “Degas.”

artworks.title: Studies of the Colosseum and Monte Pincio (verso)
artworks.medium: graphite with white heightening on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image shows pencil sketches on tan paper portraying various architectural views and elements in a loose, informal style. The sketches include a cityscape with domed structures in the distance and architectural details like arches and stonework. The horizon is high on the paper, and there is a mix of quick lines and shading to depict depth. The warm paper tone complements the graphite and creates a muted palette. Close-up details include arches, stonework, and a tree-like shape. The focus is on form and composition rather than detailed realism.

artworks.title: Geneva, Hobart College
artworks.description: The image shows a dirt road lined with trees leading to buildings in the distance. The trees create a canopy above the road, with branches extending in different directions. The buildings are partially shaded by lush foliage, blending them into the surroundings. One building is covered in ivy. The photo has a sepia tone, with colors of brown and beige. The textures of the road and leaves add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Cayuga Lake Toward Ithaca
artworks.description: The image shows a lakeside view from a slightly elevated perspective. Lush trees with dense foliage frame the scene, leading towards the expansive lake. The calm lake reflects muted tones. Rolling hills with fields, trees, and occasional structures are seen on the horizon. The sky above has soft clouds. The color palette is primarily earthy browns and greens, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Cliff View, Through the Trees
artworks.description: The image shows a forest with tall trees and a view of distant mountains in the background. The forest floor is covered with tangled roots and leaves, while the mountains appear in soft, layered silhouettes beyond the trees. The photo has a sepia tone, with rich shades of brown and green for the foliage. Light and shadow add depth to the composition, while the mountains in the background are blurred, creating a sense of distance.

artworks.title: Picnic Grounds
artworks.description: The image shows a tree-lined path with benches placed at intervals. The path extends into the distance, framed by tall trees forming a natural archway. The trees lean slightly inward, creating a tunnel effect with their canopies. Light filters through the branches, casting shadows on the path. The color palette is sepia-toned.

artworks.title: Easton and Weygat Mountain
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river meandering through a valley, viewed from an elevated position, likely from a hill or mountain. The horizon is located in the upper third of the photograph, with rolling hills meeting the sky. Distant hills run across the horizon. The image is detailed, and the landscape is framed by leafy branches. The color palette is brown and muted greens, resembling a sepia tone. A town can be seen in the distance, along the riverbanks, with houses, fields, and forests under soft lighting.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.description: The image shows a high vantage point overlooking a rural landscape. A river flows across the scene with a bridge crossing over it. The landscape features greenery, open fields, a small town, and wooded hills in the distance. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving the image an aged appearance.

artworks.title: Red Rocks Near Allen's
artworks.description: The image shows a set of railway tracks extending into the distance on the right side, gradually converging towards the high horizon. Beyond the tracks, there is a body of water reflecting the landscape. Hills rise on both sides of the water, with the right side showing a densely vegetated hillside and the left side featuring a more gradual rise with a mix of trees and open land. The horizon barely peeks over the distant hills on the left. The overall color palette is sepia-toned, giving a timeless, vintage aesthetic with light and shadow across the landscape. The scene is tranquil, with boats on the water surface adding details to the composition.

artworks.title: East View of Standing Stone
artworks.description: The landscape photograph displays a view of railway tracks amidst natural scenery. Rolling hills covered in trees are seen against the sky. The tracks run diagonally, bordered by grassy terrain. A river curves gently in the distance, reflecting light. Tall trees frame the scene, creating a visual path along the river. The color palette resembles a soft sepia tone. The image conveys a sense of tranquility and beauty, emphasizing the blend of human infrastructure and nature.

artworks.title: Susquehanna at Standing Stone
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a river curving into the distance. A path or road runs alongside the river on the right, bordered by grass and shrubbery. Trees are scattered throughout the scene, and a tall tree stands out prominently. A densely wooded hillside slopes down towards the river on the left. The horizon is hazy with rolling hills faintly visible under a clear sky. The image is in black and white, creating a timeless and classic feel with subtle light and shadow.

artworks.title: Musconetcong Curve
artworks.description: The image shows railway tracks curving through a hilly landscape covered with trees. The viewpoint is elevated, looking down on the scene. The horizon is high in the image where the sky meets the forested hills. The photo is realistic, capturing details of the trees and textures. The color palette is mainly sepia-toned with variations in brown and beige. It conveys a sense of tranquility and timelessness, contrasting the railway with the natural surroundings.

artworks.title: Cathedral Rocks, Susquehanna Near Meshoppen
artworks.description: The image depicts a railway line running through a landscape. A cliff face covered with patches of vegetation is visible to the left of the tracks. On the right, there is a body of water reflecting the sky. In the distance, hills merge with an overcast sky with soft clouds. The color palette is mostly sepia-toned. The tracks lead towards the horizon, creating a sense of depth in the serene landscape.

artworks.title: Beechwood Lake
artworks.description: The image shows a low angle view near narrow-gauge railroad tracks running diagonally. A line of dense trees marks the horizon, separating the sky from a body of water. Several trees fill the scene, casting shadows and creating a textured canopy. The color palette is subdued with sepia tones. Light filters through the branches, creating a serene atmosphere that extends into the water and distant trees. The placement of tracks and natural elements creates a balance between man-made and natural features.

artworks.title: Glen Onoko, Onoko Falls
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall flowing over a rocky cliff. The viewpoint is from below the falls, looking up at the cascading water. Foliage covers the top of the falls, obscuring the horizon. The waterfall appears blurred due to long exposure, contrasting with the sharp rocks. The color scheme is sepia, giving a vintage look. Rocks, vegetation, and some leaves are visible in the foreground.

artworks.title: Ganoga Lake Branch
artworks.description: The image displays railway tracks running through a dense forest. The tracks extend diagonally into the forested landscape, with tall trees bordering them. The foliage forms a canopy over the tracks, obscuring the sky. The trees are detailed, showing their leaves and bark. The color palette is a sepia tone, giving the image an aged look. Logs and stumps are visible along the track's path.

artworks.title: Across Country from West Portal, N.J.
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high in the image, with distant hills fading into the sky. Small wooden farmhouses, barns, trees, and open fields are visible on rolling hills. Some barns with slanted roofs are on the right, and a few cows are grazing to the left. The color palette is sepia tones, giving a vintage and tranquil atmosphere. Trees line a winding road leading to the hazy background.
